headline: Dexco Raises R$ 200 Million via Subsidiary Stake Sale to Institutional Investor
summary: Dexco raised R$ 200 million through the sale of preferred shares in its forestry subsidiary Araucaria Florestal to an institutional investor.
why: Capital raises through subsidiary divestments allow industrial conglomerates to optimize balance sheets and fund capital expenditures.

impacts.name: Dexco
impacts.why: Capital injections from equity sales improve liquidity and capital resources for parent companies.
